title: caralluma mammillaris
intro: Caralluma mammillaris, commonly known as Caralluma, is a type of succulent plant that belongs to the Apocynaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional Indian medicine for centuries to aid in weight loss, reduce hunger, and improve overall health. The health benefits of Caralluma include appetite suppression, improved insulin sensitivity, and reduced inflammation, making it a potential therapeutic agent for managing obesity and metabolic disorders. The bioactive constituents of Caralluma include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-obesity effects.
